CapOverrides.description:
One Upstream's or one Proxy's Caps: unset keeps what it inherits, set only ever lowers
it.

tool_name.description: Ceiling on an exposed tool name, in characters.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

tool_description.description: Ceiling on an exposed tool description, in characters.
tool_description.title: Tool Description

argument_description.description: Ceiling on an exposed argument description, in characters.
argument_description.title: Argument Description

instructions.description: Ceiling on the Proxy's exposed instructions, in characters.
instructions.title: Instructions

tool_output.description: Ceiling on a tool call's answer, in characters.
tool_output.title: Tool Output

CapOverrides.title: CapOverrides

auth.description: How the Upstream is authorized. "oauth" logs in through the provider once, from the CLI, and keeps the token encrypted in the state directory; unset sends no credentials.
auth.title: Auth

scopes.description: OAuth scopes to ask the provider for. Empty leaves the choice to the provider and what the Upstream's metadata advertises.
scopes.title: Scopes

lifecycle.description: This Upstream's lifecycle settings, over the defaults in config.toml.

caps.description: This Upstream's Caps, over the global master Caps in config.toml.

LifecycleOverrides.description: One Upstream's lifecycle settings: whatever it sets wins over the global defaults.

warm.description: Connect at Daemon start and ping on an interval, instead of waiting for the first call. Warm Upstreams never go idle.
warm.title: Warm

idle_timeout.description: Seconds without a call before the connection is let go. 0 keeps it forever.
idle_timeout.title: Idle Timeout

connect_timeout.description: Seconds a connect attempt may take before it counts as a failure.
connect_timeout.title: Connect Timeout

ping_interval.description: Seconds between pings of a warm Upstream, so it is never falsely reported up.
ping_interval.title: Ping Interval

unavailable_message.description: The tool error a call is answered with while the Upstream is not connected.
unavailable_message.title: Unavailable Message
